about_the_game:
Super Muscle Knight is a brand-new kind of “climbing action” game where you strike macho poses on your way to the top.

You play as a muscle-bound man wearing a mysterious horse mask that generates magnetic power whenever he flexes.

No matter how many times you fall, you’ll never die—so keep climbing until your spirit breaks, not your body.

A 2D Platformer in Pixel Art

Step into a retro‑styled world built with lovingly crafted pixel art. The environments look simple at first glance, yet are intricately designed to feel both nostalgic and fresh.

Collapsing ledges that drop you into the abyss, slippery ice platforms that send you sliding, and searing lava obstacles you can’t even touch—welcome to a pixel world full of peril.

The warmth of classic pixel art fused with modern, snappy controls creates a game that’s instantly approachable, yet endlessly replayable.

Muscle Poses that Command Magnetism

Flex your muscles to unleash magnetic power and reach heights no normal jump could ever achieve.

Scattered across the world are magnets of N and S polarity—use their pull and push to climb ever higher.

Sometimes bold, sometimes clever—the way you use magnetism opens countless routes to the summit.

Walls too high to scale? Obstacles blocking your way? Strike a pose and power through with magnetic force!

When in doubt, take a breath and look around. A hidden path or shortcut might be waiting, if you know how to bend magnetism to your will.

Everything Can Be Lost in an Instant

One mistake can erase the entire path you’ve built.

Even after a long and careful climb, a single slip at the final step will send you crashing down, forcing you to start over. That’s why every move carries tension—and why success feels so extraordinary.

Will you keep risking failure and push forward, or play it safe? The choice is yours.

But do not forget… just one moment of carelessness can take everything away.

Video and Streaming Guidelines

We welcome uploads and live streams of this game!

As long as you follow these rules, both individuals and organizations may share freely without prior permission.

  • Monetization is allowed only through official platform features (e.g., ads, subscriptions, etc.). Any other commercial use is not permitted.

  • Modification or alteration of game data, or use of extracted assets, is strictly prohibited.

  • Please ensure that your content does not infringe on the rights of third parties or cause damages. B.B.Alpha Games shall not be held liable for issues arising from uploads or streams.

  • These guidelines may change without notice and apply to future uploads.

  • Any other acts that we deem inappropriate or harmful to the game or its community are prohibited.

※ If possible, we would appreciate it if you could include the game title and/or a link to the Steam page in the description of your video or stream.
